summary: The confirmed_not_located closure is justified for both hypothalamus contrasts. All 89 source files matched their recorded hashes and sizes, and all seven computations reproduced. I corrected the scope of one BioProject search and clarified the edgeR row counts. DSS published 18,327 of 18,422 tested rows. Opa1 published 19,268 of 19,385. The corrected proposal passed validation.
openIssues: The reviewed public sources yielded no matched author gene-level results for either contrast. Author effect sizes, tested genes, P values, FDR and concordance remain unassessed.
